description: Layout primitives: Stack and Row for gaps in one direction, Grid for an auto-fitting set of cards. `gap` is a token step, never a raw px.
example:
const cards = ['Drafts', 'In review', 'Published']
/* Spacing lives on the container (gap), never as child margins. `gap` takes a
 * step of the 4pt scale: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 6 | 8 | 12 | 16. */

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Grid gap={4}>
    {cards.map((c) => (
      <Card key={c}><CardTitle>{c}</CardTitle></Card>
    ))}
  </Grid>
  <Row gap={2}>
    <Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button>
    <Button variant="primary">Save</Button>
  </Row>
</Stack>
